ItemID: 1; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try this to add control of a lamp alongside my existing connected devices.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display interests me, but I'd choose the larger Show 8 this time.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose this for a larger screen and investigate whether it can display my security cameras.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K Fire TV Stick and a Fire TV television, so an HD stick adds little.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm more interested in a display for my connected home than another voice-only device.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don't currently need a separate smart speaker, even though it fits the Alexa ecosystem.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An older voice-only speaker doesn't address a current need for me.
ItemID: 8; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on television and cameras; I don't currently need a tablet.
ItemID: 9; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K stick, and the themed cover gives me no practical reason to replace it.
ItemID: 10; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current computer storage upgrade planned or confirmed need for a SATA drive.
